questions.question: Which of the following represents the correct floral formula for Pisum sativum?
questions.solution:
Pisum sativum (garden pea) belongs to the family Fabaceae.

The flowers of Fabaceae are zygomorphic ($\text{\%}$) and bisexual.

The calyx consists of 5 united sepals ($\text{K}_{(5)}$).

The corolla is papilionaceous, consisting of 5 petals: 1 standard, 2 wings, and 2 fused keel petals ($\text{C}_{1+2+(2)}$).

The androecium consists of 10 stamens which are diadelphous ($\text{A}_{(9)+1}$).

The gynoecium is monocarpellary with a superior ovary ($\underline{\text{G}}_{1}$).

Therefore, the correct floral formula is $\%$, Bisexual, $\text{K}_{(5)}\ \text{C}_{1+2+(2)}\ \text{A}_{(9)+1}\ \underline{\text{G}}_{1}$.
